title: Beyond Rough Volatility: Decoupling Memory and Scaling via a Generalized Langevin Equation
abstract: arXiv:2609.20293v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Borrowed from non-equilibrium statistical mechanics, the generalized Langevin equation (GLE) is imported as a framework for stochastic volatility to address the structural limitations of fractional Brownian motion (fBm), the standard engine of rough volatility. The fBm forces a single parameter to set two logically independent properties at once: how volatility scales and how it remembers. The GLE separates them using a memory kernel $K$, a potential $U$, and a noise covariance $C$. Memory becomes a measurable object, and an asymmetric potential supplies a lever on variance skew that the price-variance correlation cannot reach. Physical-measure tests on public datasets decisively reject two constrained corners of the class, a memoryless leverage effect and time-reversal symmetry, while the central rough scaling constraint is left identification-limited rather than refuted. translated_title: 超越粗糙波动率：通过广义朗之万方程解耦记忆与标度特性
translated_abstract: 借鉴非平衡统计力学，本文将广义朗之万方程（GLE）引入作为随机波动率的框架，以解决分数布朗运动（fBm）——粗糙波动率的标准引擎——的结构性局限。fBm 迫使单一参数同时设定两个逻辑上独立的性质：波动率如何标度以及它如何记忆。GLE 通过记忆核 $K$、势能 $U$ 和噪声协方差 $C$ 将二者分离。由此，记忆成为一个可测量的对象，而非对称势能则提供了一个价格-方差相关性无法触及的方差偏度调节杠杆。在公开数据集上的物理测度检验果断拒绝了该类模型中的两个受限情形——无记忆杠杆效应和时间反演对称性——而核心的粗糙标度约束则是受限于可识别性而非被驳斥。论文诚实地报告了这些局限，并在工业数据上进行了验证
tldr: 该论文提出用源自非平衡统计力学的广义朗之万方程（GLE）作为随机波动率新框架，通过记忆核、势能和噪声协方差三个独立要素，解耦了分数布朗运动被迫绑定的波动率标度与记忆特性，并通过实证检验拒绝了无记忆杠杆效应和时间反演对称性这两个受限设定。
